name: switchboard
description: See and message your other Claude Code sessions: who is working on what, direct messages, broadcast, handoffs, an inbox that holds incoming messages for approval, and live warnings when another session edited the same file

incoming.title: Switchboard: messages from other sessions
incoming.description: deliver: other sessions' messages reach Claude as they arrive (Claude Code's default). hold-other-repos: deliver from sessions in the same repository, hold the rest in the inbox for you to pass on. hold: hold every message until you pass it on.

collisions.title: Switchboard: when another session edited the same file
collisions.description: warn: show a warning and let the edit go ahead. ask: ask you before the edit. off: do nothing.

collisionMinutes.title: Switchboard: how recent an edit counts as a collision (minutes)
collisionMinutes.description: Another session's edit to the same file within this many minutes triggers the warning.
